known_risks: 中文：用户接受当前候选在重弩普通/蹲射姿态切换前后可能出现约 1～2 发状态或 HUD 同步延迟；是否属于原版 MH3G 行为尚未证实，皮皮鸟独立复测仍待回执。 / English: The user accepts a possible one-to-two-shot state or HUD synchronization delay around HBG normal/siege stance changes for this candidate; a vanilla MH3G origin is unproven and independent PipiNiao retest feedback is pending.

中文：一旦真实备弹归零后仍可无限生成弹丸、左上计数持续为负、输入卡死或崩溃，必须判失败，不能归入上述 1～2 发延迟。 / English: Indefinite projectile generation after zero real reserve, a persistently negative HUD counter, stuck input, or a crash is a failure and is not covered by the accepted one-to-two-shot delay.
中文：不得与 #25、#52、旧 V1～V9 或任何其他修改弹药状态的 Pack 同时启用。 / English: Do not combine with #25, #52, V1-V9, or any other pack that modifies ammunition state.

summary: 中文：铳枪开火后自动补回炮弹；轻弩和重弩普通射击后自动回填当前弹仓，同时真实弹药仍按原版逐发消耗，回填量不超过弹仓容量与当前备弹中的较小值。 状态：Runtime Experimental，默认关闭；用户接受姿态切换附近可能约 1～2 发同步延迟作为当前已知限制，皮皮鸟独立复测待回执。 / English: Automatically refills Gunlance shells and the current LBG/HBG magazine after normal shots while real ammunition is still consumed one round at a time, clamped to the smaller of magazine capacity and current reserve. Status: Runtime Experimental; disabled by default. The user accepts a possible one-to-two-shot sync delay around stance changes as the current known limitation; independent PipiNiao retest feedback is pending.
